about: Waveform dots: whole-pixel point sizes with area-compensated alpha (commit 4fc2eea), size = max(1, ceil(base*scale)), alpha *= (base*scale)^2 / size^2. Synthetic fDecay=0 presets (geo-dots.py), mean luma and lit pixels of quad dots against GL points, same frames.

before_5a3bbb9.note: measured at 1280x720 with reference height 1080 (scale 0.667): the 1.33 px point rasterised as 1 px

final_build_note: Since 31b8cbf the scale never drops below 1, so the 720 case no longer occurs; the whole-pixel rule now applies at non-integer scales above 1 (1.62 at 1080, 3.25 at 4K with the 1024x768 reference, e.g. 3.25 px -> 4 px point, alpha x0.66).
